Existing authored profile and span controls are retained. East-bank PMTiles34.8258m conflicts with the original authored gateway threshold; approximate local preview contacts retain that source profile rather than certifying a new datum. Bounded opening removes bridge imprint. Exact bank joins, water stage, stone courses and crown restoration appearance remain limited;2007picture does not verify2026copper cap.
